pr.title: Set the band's divider apart with a blank line
pr.head: f5508c8317370efa90f57f82d35dfb746f4f82d1

summary: Projector's Claude Code plugin draws a band above the prompt: a list of the open pull requests that the session's review and fix loops track, one line each, with any open questions from those loops below them. The band's first row is a divider, a dimmed line of ─ characters that ends with the question count and how long ago the band reloaded, such as updated 12s ago.

Before this change the first pull request sat directly under the divider, so the divider's text ran into the rows. The band now draws a blank line under the divider, both when it lists pull requests or questions and when it has nothing to list. When you open a question's drawer, the question still has the band to itself, with no divider and no blank line above it.
The documentation's examples of the band show the new blank line, and a test checks for it.

groups.title: A blank line under the divider
groups.kicker: The band's render adds one blank row after its divider
intro: The band renders in the ui.render handler for the AbovePrompt component in hooks/register.tsx. The handler returns one of three layouts. Each layout is a column of rows, and a Text that holds one space is how the file draws a blank row.

• Nothing to list. The divider, then a status message such as Looking for pull requests…. This layout gains the blank line.
  • A question's drawer is open. Only the question and its drawer. This layout returns before the divider is drawn, so it is unchanged.
  • Pull requests, questions, or both. The divider, the pull request rows, then a blank line and the questions when both are present. This layout gains the blank line under the divider.

checks.text: The new assertion fails without the change. With the base hooks/register.tsx restored, claude plugin test . fails draws one line per open pull request of the session’s own loops. At fcd12ab all 52 tests passed, and the later push changes only comments.

files.note: Adds the blank row under the divider in the empty layout and in the main layout. It also updates the comment above focused and drops the comment that listed the main layout's rows.

checks.text: When a question's drawer is open, the band skips both the divider and the blank line under it, so the drawer gets two more rows before it has to scroll. The engine caps the band below half the terminal's height.

With questions and no pull requests, the band draws the divider, this blank line, and then the questions. The before-questions blank line appears only when there are both rows and questions, so no second blank line is drawn. Checked by reading the conditions.

files.note: Checks that the row after the divider is a blank Text.

groups.title: Band examples in the documentation
groups.kicker: Every drawing of the band shows the blank line
intro: docs/plugins.md describes the band for users, and the questions and inbox plans draw it in their designs. Each example now has a blank line under the divider, and docs/plugins.md says that the blank line sets the divider apart from the rows.

checks.text: A search of the Markdown files for the divider's updated … ago text finds these four examples of the band and no other, and each shows the blank line. The questions plan stays in-progress and the inbox plan stays ready. Only their examples change.
